calculateAssignmentWeight(address).details: DR v1: Helper function that maps quality score to assignment weight.      Can be used by governance to set weights, but manual control is preferred.      Thresholds: qualityScore < 5000 → weight=0, qualityScore >= 5000 → weight=qualityScore

finalizeDispute(uint256,address).details: Called when appeal window expires or final round decision is made      Triggers onDisputeFinalized hook and distributes any remaining appeal bonds

forceProgress(uint256,address).details: Anyone can call. If resolver timeout occurred, auto-reassigns within same round or escalates.      Records timeout penalty, updates EMA score, calls incentive hooks.

returns._0: Array of accepted bond token addresses

getAppealDeadlineAndRound(uint256,addres.details: Used by BaseEscrow to enforce appeal windows before executing transfers

returns.appealDeadline: Appeal deadline for current round (0 if no deadline or final round)
returns.isFinalRound: True if this is the final round (MAX_ROUND)

getDecisionAtRound(uint256,address,uint8.details: Returns the decision made at the specified round

returns.decision: ResolutionOutcome enum value (0 = NONE, 1 = RELEASE, 2 = CANCEL)

returns.isAdd: Whether change is adding (true) or removing (false)

getRequiredAppealBond(uint256,address,ui.details: Calculates bond based on escalation cost curve configuration

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getV1PhaseGateMetrics().details: DR v1: Used to assess readiness for DR v2 upgrade      Exit criteria: stable escalation rate, predictable response times, operational resolvers

returns.avgResponseTime: Average resolution time in seconds (0 if no resolutions)
returns.escalationRate: Escalation rate (basis points: escalations / total disputes * 10000)

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

moduleVersion().details: Must follow semantic versioning: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH      Major version changes indicate breaking changes

pauseNewAssignments(string).details: When paused, selectResolverRoundRobin() and selectResolverWithQuality() return address(0)      Existing disputes continue processing normally      Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK (slow lane) or ROLE_GUARDIAN (emergency)

params.module: New slashing module address (can be address(0) to disable)
New staking module address (can be address(0) to disable)

recordResolution(uint256,address,address.details: Updates EMA score, tracks decision in round-based metadata, calls incentive hooks

recordReversal(uint256,address,uint8).details: Called when a decision at priorRound is overturned by decision at priorRound+1      Updates EMA score with penalty for the original resolver

params.priorRound: Round where original decision was made

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

resumeNewAssignments().details: Requires ROLE_TIMELOCK (slow lane). Guardian is down-only and cannot resume.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.alphaBps: EMA step parameter in basis points (e.g., 1000 = 10%)
params.maxTimeoutRate: Maximum timeout rate in basis points (e.g., 3000 = 30%)
params.minScoreThreshold: Minimum EMA score to receive work (e.g., 500000 = 50%)

setResolverAssignmentWeight(address,uint.details: DR v1: Primary lever for performance-based routing. Weight=0 excludes resolver from selection.      Weight is multiplied with quality score in quality-based selection.      Default weight for new resolvers is 10000 (full weight).

params.weight: Assignment weight (0-10000 basis points, 0 = workload to zero)

params.roundAppealWindows: Array of appeal windows per round [0, 1, 2]
params.roundResolveDeadlines: Array of resolve deadlines per round [0, 1, 2]
